messages:
jamie (PM): Heads-up: Acme just escalated. They need enterprise SSO for their pilot (SAML + user sync). This is likely a blocker unless we redefine the pilot requirements.
sara (eng): Implementing SAML auth is doable quickly, SCIM/user-provisioning is the bigger lift. SCIM touches our tenancy model and provisioning flows.
devin (infra): If we commit them to Dedicated we can avoid building private networking for now. That buys time for SCIM. But Dedicated implies reserved capacity and config changes.
jamie (PM): Options: 1) MVP includes SAML-only (auth), SCIM deferred to v1; 2) Keep current MVP, pilot with OIDC fallback; 3) Delay pilot until full SAML+SCIM. Which is realistic?
raj (sales): From the customer convo, "SAML in pilot" is the ask. OIDC fallback likely won't pass their IT security gate. They may pause pilot if we say OIDC-only.
maria (design): UX-wise we can ship a lightweight SAML flow: connect, test assertion, enable. That covers the immediate perception of enterprise readiness.
sara (eng): Engineering estimate: SAML-auth integration via our SSO proxy + existing libs: ~2.5 wks (2 engs). SCIM initial MVP (basic push) is another 3-4 weeks and requires review of user lifecycle semantics.
devin (infra): Also need a console guardrail: force tenant onto Dedicated with audit logs and a toggle for the pilot so we don't auto-route. I can add the toggle + logging in ~3 days.
jamie (PM): Suggested triage: Accept SAML-auth in MVP if pilot runs on Dedicated and we ship a SCIM v1 commitment. Embeddings cache and tenant-routing perf can be cut to v1. Thoughts?
sara (eng): Embeddings cache is cost-saving but not blocking for pilot. Tenant-routing is riskier; we can soft-disable tenant-routing for pilot tenants. That reduces complexity.
raj (sales): I can negotiate a LOI if we promise SAML auth for pilot and firm timeline for SCIM in v1. They need audit logs and per-tenant controls though.
maria (design): I'll produce a minimal SSO setup UX and the error states. Also a modal explaining Dedicated-only constraint for pilot.
jamie (PM): New MVP cutoff: feature-freeze 2026-05-18. If SAML-auth deliverables miss that date, fallback = OIDC-only pilot (sales to notify customer).
devin (infra): Canary capacity check: Dedicated pool in ap-south region has 2 small nodes free. rollout-bot: no capacity pressure currently.
rollout-bot: dedicated-pool-check: available_nodes=2, region=ap-south, note="sufficient for pilot but monitor"
sara (eng): Action items: 1) spike SAML libs and 3rd-party proxies (2d), 2) prototype auth flow (5d), 3) add e2e assertion test (3d), 4) perf test on Dedicated (2d). I'll own these.
jamie (PM): I'll update the roadmap and open triage doc. I'll mark embeddings-cache -> v1 and tenant-routing -> v1.
raj (sales): I'll draft customer note: "SAML auth enabled for pilot; SCIM and full tenant-routing scheduled for v1." Will share draft.
maria (design): Mockups will be in Figma under "SSO pilot minimal".
jamie (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene Friday for status. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me and I'll escalate priorities. :thumbsup:
